settings.text: We're building Teacher Moves to make the entire journey clearer.
settings.image_alt: Mpume (Edwina) Shangase, founder of Teacher Moves

settings.heading: Expat Teacher's Lounge began with one teacher's moves.
settings.text:
South Africa to the UK. The UK to Qatar. Qatar to Canada. Each move meant joining Facebook groups, searching everything and piecing together information from ten different places, half of it outdated.

Expat Teacher's Lounge started as a way to share what that experience taught: the contracts, the documents, the planning and the moments nobody warns you about.

settings.heading: What teachers kept struggling with
settings.text: The same questions came up again and again.

settings.label: Which province or country fits me?

settings.heading: One place for the whole journey.
settings.text:
Teacher Moves brings community, resources and personalised services together, starting with Canada as our first flagship pathway.

What we're building toward (in development): clearer readiness tools, document tracking and smarter guidance, so more teachers can plan their move with confidence. Today, every assessment and report is prepared personally.

settings.heading: Mpume (Edwina) Shangase
settings.text:
18 years of teaching across South Africa, the United Kingdom, Qatar and Canada, where she now teaches in New Brunswick. A PMP-certified project manager who plans moves the way she plans projects: step by step, with nothing left to guesswork.

She moves with her family, so every recommendation considers the whole household, not just the contract.
settings.closing: Teacher Moves exists to make the next move clearer for teachers coming behind us.

settings.heading: Make your next move with us.
